text: 1 days ago Buskers Fest 2026 is the perfect opportunity to experience the arts firsthand right here in Boone. Buskers Fest goes beyond traditional street performance to celebrate a vibrant mix of artistic expression. Busking is a rich Appalachian tradition and is embedded in the town’s cultural heartbeat. At Buskers Fest you will be able to: browse and purchase artwork, enjoy live music, participate in interactive art projects, and grab some delicious food and drinks. This is a free event that is open to the public, but encourage to have cash or Venmo handy for purchasing work or tipping musicians! We encourage everyone to come out and become fully immersed in the world of busking! Read full article
